title: The updater
patterns: how does the installer updater help
response: The updater is a panel that shows every application in the package with its last update date, and downloads the newest installer straight into the correct folder on your drive. It is the difference between a USB stick you trust for years and one that is obsolete in three months.

title: The tweaks panel
response: It groups the repetitive post-format chores into single clicks: desktop and explorer icons, power plans, temp file cleanup, OneDrive control, the Windows 11 context menu and Windows Update repair — the things you do on nearly every machine anyway.
